inference.origin_contemporary: 10 of 12 model-proximity source->destination directions have some WCVP species registered native at source, alien at destination, not evidence species drifted
inference.model_nearshore: Only 12 of 7313 source-evaluable directional TDWG3 pairs have a coarse 2005 NOAA 90d current trajectory passing within 50km of another botanical region, 4 modelled raster land contacts, not biological arrival
inference.artificial_offshore_release: Actual NOAA source coarse 1 degree subsampled, 1-3 dated starts up to 200km from a representative coastline; 10 of 12 passes after day7 and displacement50km, not independent dispersal samples
inference.ship: No overlap of the 12 current-model-positive direction with exact original 2020 verified WPI AIS port-to-port directed episodes; do not interpret the other 7313 as zero shipping
inference.verdict: Source support for real directional-current × botanical sharing vs 2020 AIS shipping predictive comparison FAILS; no regression fitted, original GEB positive results unchanged

limits: Contemporary source-native destination-alien WCVP taxon identity is not plant species seed-transport history.
12 model coastal proximities are not 12 true seed dispersal events; 4 coast pixel hits not 4 botanical colonizations.
2005 old NOAA OSCAR 1degree-decimated 15m 3-release/90-day snapshots differ from global historical current networks and 2020 AIS actual transit records.
The source model itself predeclared analysis-eligibility gate only after source feasibility; not an independently pre-registered power test.
No valid independent global shipping network or true plant colonization chronology or independent butterfly occurrence responses joined here.
